coefficients.scope: Extrema from the independently bound metadata audit, not a new posterior diagnostic calculation

functionals.scope: Extrema from the independently bound metadata audit, not a new posterior diagnostic calculation

hyperparameters.scope: Extrema from the independently bound metadata audit, not a new posterior diagnostic calculation

operations.interpretation: All immutable attempt elapsed times, including historical job IDs and interrupted attempts, plus preparation once. Worker wall time is not CPU time; admission limits are checked before groups, not hard-kill deadlines.
operations.process_peak_rss_interpretation: Receipt process_peak_rss is a per-process maximum; it is not simultaneous campaign RSS. Cgroup memory includes page cache; no OOM conclusion is inferred from this audit.

complementary_metadata_audit.scope: Closed native campaign accounting, source bindings, all-parameter receipt qualification and nine selected invariance checks; fixed-reference arithmetic is covered by this numerical audit

limits.interpretation: Per-origin metric arithmetic and report aggregation were independently checked. Raw CRPS/path quantile calculations rely on the frozen scoring implementation and its prior acceptance checks. Six saved means/truth/90% bounds were directly checked.

methods.episode_rmse: sqrt(mean over all origin/lead spatial MSE), then equally weighted trajectory means
methods.failure_policy: finite divergences retained; nonfinite/unavailable origins exclude entire trajectory from accuracy but remain in full schedule census
methods.matched_seeds: 4 trajectories x8 origins per seed; alternate minus matched main; no comparison with14-trajectory main mean
methods.target: clean simulated field, physical units; permitted full-training scalar SD for normalized scores
methods.uncertainty: 2000 trajectory-cluster bootstrap resamples, seed20261105; pointwise horizon intervals; conditional on frozen selection and complete cases

scope: Independent reconstruction from immutable origin metrics; no model or report aggregation imports
